items.mainDefect: The catch block increments retryCount for any exception in the try block, including a failed prisma update after twilio.scheduleSMS has already succeeded, so a reminder with a live Twilio SMS can be retried and later deleted.

secondary.defect: The new deleteMany OR branch is missing a method: SMS scope and a scheduled: false filter, despite the comment saying it is SMS-only, so it can delete non-SMS or already-scheduled reminder rows.
